description: Post-pushforward Frobenius spectra of hook cohomologies H^1_c(U, Lambda^i Std) for the fixed-q root cover P_{q,t}(z)=q z^p+z^3-3z-(q-2)t, U = P^1 \ {1,-1,oo}. L_i(T) = det(1 - T Frob | H^1_c). All from exact python-flint cycle-type censuses.

p5.census_range: j=1..9, q in {1,3,4}; every L_i determined by j<=h_i and validated on all remaining j (out-of-sample through j=9)

identifications.disc_unit: disc_z P_{q,t} = u_q (t^2-1), u_q = 3 q (q-2)^2; L4 = 1 - chi(u_q) T = 1 + chi(q) T (chi(3)=-1 mod 5). The weight-0 survivor is ALWAYS exactly this Kummer class.
identifications.V1_V0: reduced permutation module on the 9 punctures (infinity + critical fibers (z-+1)^2 * cubic g_+-); pure weight 0
identifications.V3_weight1: = H^1(D_q), D_q: w^2 = u_q g_+(z) g_-(z) genus 2; verified by independent point counts: L(D_1)=(1+5T^2)(1-4T+5T^2), L(D_3)=(1-T+5T^2)(1+3T+5T^2), L(D_4)=(1-3T+5T^2)(1+T+5T^2)
identifications.V2_weight1: = H^1 anti-part of pair curve B_q: (P_q(z1)-P_q(z2))/(z1-z2)=0 (S_2-quotient rational); verified by independent counts: a(B_1)=0 [1+5T^2], a(B_3)=2 [1-2T+5T^2], a(B_4)=-2 [1+2T+5T^2]
identifications.q1_extra_cancellation: H^1(B_1)=(1+5T^2) is an isogeny factor of Jac(D_1) -> rank drops 7 -> 3; accidental, absent at q=3,4 and at sampled generic q in F_25

p5.exact_count_formula: 5 I_j(q) = 5^j - E_j, E_j = (-chi(q))^j + a_j(B_q) - a_j(D_q); verified all q, j<=9
p5.q2_degenerate_slice: X^5+2X^3+X+d = x(x^2+1)^2+d cover, branch {0,oo}: census gives L(V_0..V_3) = (1-T)^{1,2,2,2} and sgn sheaf TRIVIAL (colliding critical values make disc = unit * square), so H^2_c(V_4) = Q_l(-1) is a second Tate class and I_j = 2*5^(j-1) EXACTLY (verified j<=8). The q=2 boundary contributes n_+(2)=2 needed to close CVN.2: N_1(5)=0+2+2+0=4, N_2(5)=2+0+0+2+2=6 both match the validation table
p5.cvn_check: n_+(q) = census irreducible-t count I_1(q) exactly: (2,0,2) for q=(1,3,4)

epsilon_minus_families.p5: nonsplit slice X^5-(eta q)^{-1}X^3+3q^{-1}X+d towers computed j<=7 (nonsplit_towers_p5.json). q=1: E^-_j = (-1)^j E_j EXACTLY (global quadratic twist). q=3: unique rank-7 fit: Kummer flips (+1->-1), B-factor kept (a=2), D-factors {1,-3} -> {-1,-3} (one factor quadratically twisted). q=4: Kummer flips (-1->+1), B kept (a=-2), D {3,-1} -> {3,1}. RULE: nonsplit family = same surviving object with Kummer class and exactly one D-factor sign-flipped.
epsilon_minus_families.p7: towers j<=6 (nonsplit_towers_p7.json): even-j E^- equals untwisted E exactly (forced: quadratic extension splits the twist), odd-j shows partial factor flips; q=1: [-7,-49,77,119,-147,1631] vs [7,-49,-77,119,637,1631]
epsilon_minus_families.consequence: n_+(q) and n_-(q) are the two Frobenius readings of ONE surviving object per q; p n_+/-(q) = p -/+ E_1-type traces

j1_positivity_structure: p=7: q=1,6 (irreducible quintic critical fibers) have ZERO irreducible fibers over F_7 (E_1 = +7 = p); q=3,4,5 have 2 each (E_1 = -7). Pointwise Weil at j=1 is vacuous when surviving rank ~ p; positivity of N_a comes from the q-average (CVN.2), i.e. the crown needs the q-line assembly of the surviving curve families, not per-q bounds.
q2_boundary_p7: p=7 q=2 slice (2x^7+x^3-3x+d): disc = -3d^2 (unit square), I_j = [2*7^j + 2*Re((i sqrt7)^j)]/7 exactly (verified j<=4): two Tate classes + supersingular elliptic factor
